To Pontius washing His Hands

Richard Crashaw (c. 1613–1649)

M
ATT.
 
XXVII.
 24
.
T
HY
 hands are washt; but O, the water’s spilt
That labour’d to have washt thy guilt:
The flood, if any can, that can suffice;
Must have its fountain in thine eyes.
